cases.name: Diane Martin Cusick
cases.about: She was a Long Island dance teacher.
cases.narrative:
On 2/16/1968, after she did not return home from a trip to buy shoes, her father found her body in the back seat of her car, outside the Green Acres Mall in Valley Stream, NY. She had adhesive tape around her mouth and neck. She had been beaten, raped and strangled. Her hands also bore defensive wounds. DNA from semen discovered at the crime scene matched a sample retrieved from Cottingham. 

Authorities believe Cottingham approached Cusick while pretending to be a mall security guard. Nassau Detective Captain Steven Fitzpatrick revealed that Cottingham would disguise himself as a store security guard – or possibly even a police officer – to approach women, claiming they had stolen something.
